title: zeltnera pusilla
intro: Zeltnera pusilla, commonly known as Pink Catchfly or Catchfly, is a perennial herbaceous plant species in the family Gentianaceae. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Zeltnera pusilla are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as an antioxidant, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
